status: BOUNDED INDEPENDENT SOURCE PEER; static claims only, no planted-data tests or privacy acceptance

claims.claim: Settings sanitizer is shallow, not recursive
claims.source_proven: Top-level credential-key values become REDACTED; string values use sanitize_path; list processing sanitizes string elements only. Other values and non-string list elements are retained. build_report formats these values with repr and joins body without another whole-body sanitizer (607-628).
claims.qualification: A nested dict/tuple/list-of-dicts can therefore carry unsanitized values. No planted fixture was executed; an actual published leak is not established.

claims.claim: public_report is path stripping of assumed pre-sanitized report, not arbitrary-payload anonymity enforcement
claims.source_proven: Outputs exactly three keys title/body/fingerprint. Applies strip_report_paths to title/body, string conversion only to fingerprint. It does not call sanitize_path/redact_secrets/redact_identity.
claims.qualification: Top-level three-key shape is not strict anonymous content allowlist. Caller contract says input comes from build_report; arbitrary supplied content or edited content is not made safe by this function. Regex path stripping has documented lower-case-tail uncertainty.

claims.claim: Editable approved payload is passed to submission without a fresh sanitizer
claims.source_proven: approved_report returns title_edit.text().strip(), body_edit.toPlainText(), original fingerprint. submit_report passes report to _post_report when authenticated, else title/body to issue_url/browser, after transport refusal check; no sanitizer in this path.
claims.qualification: Preview body initially path-stripped, but title initially copied verbatim (issue_preview90) and edits are user-authorized payload. Browser fallback opens prefilled form, not proof issue was posted; authenticated post may fail. Do not claim every submit creates public issue.

claims.claim: Diagnosis can restore removed body text by rebuilding from source body
claims.source_proven: Constructor stores report body in _source_body. _show_diagnosis sanitizes/caps analysis, checks duplicate section against _source_body, appends to _source_body then replaces entire editor text from that field. It does not read current editor edits. _refresh_body also replaces from _source_body.
claims.qualification: Docstring says edits are preserved, contrary to implementation when a new analysis is appended. Empty analysis or already-present analysis returns without replacement; lost-edit prediction is conditional on nonempty first appended diagnosis, or switch toggle. No Qt test executed.

claims.claim: show_raw=False is display suppression, not provider redaction
claims.source_proven: Preview Diagnose invokes open_error_flow(raw traceback,show_raw=False). It wraps traceback.strip() in prompt with active app, appends prompt to _ai_messages, suppresses raw console display only, and starts stream. make_stream_thread receives messages; worker calls selected provider.stream_chat with them. No issue-report sanitizer applied in this chain.
claims.qualification: No configured provider returns early. Existing diagnosis can be reused without starting another flow. Exact transport/location/retention depends selected provider; this narrow review does not assert every provider is remote or any real outbound request occurred.

claims.claim: Sanitized issue publication and AI diagnosis are separate privacy paths
claims.source_proven: Issue building sanitizes traceback and AI response; diagnosis sanitizer applies only to returned analysis when inserted, after provider input was constructed from raw traceback. Public title/body path-removal policy cannot be described as protection before AI provider receives error.
claims.qualification: No comprehensive anonymity guarantee, no strict content allowlist proven, no cloud/relay implementation acceptance from these functions.
